clicks.label: Clicks
clicks.definition: Visits through tracking links. Bots and link previews are not counted.

leads.label: Leads
leads.definition: Students who enquired through a creator's link or code and were credited to them.

qualified_leads.label: Qualified
qualified_leads.definition: Leads that reached the Qualified stage or went further.

allocated_leads.label: Allocated
allocated_leads.definition: Leads handed to an Eduwit counsellor, or further along.

applications.label: Applied
applications.definition: Leads that applied to a programme or enrolled.

enrollments.label: Enrolled
enrollments.definition: Leads that enrolled. Refunded or cancelled enrolments are not counted.

click_to_lead_rate.label: Click to lead
click_to_lead_rate.definition: Leads as a share of clicks. It can pass 100% when students type a creator code instead of clicking.

qualification_rate.label: Qualification rate
qualification_rate.definition: Share of leads that reached Qualified or further.

junk_rate.label: Junk
junk_rate.definition: Share of leads closed as junk or test enquiries.

duplicate_rate.label: Duplicates
duplicate_rate.definition: Share of enquiries that were not credited because the student had already enquired.

committed_spend.label: Committed
committed_spend.definition: Fixed fees, milestones, guarantees and extra fees Eduwit has agreed to pay on agreed and active deals, even with no leads.

accrued_spend.label: Accrued
accrued_spend.definition: What creators earned in the period, net of penalties and clawbacks, before tax.

paid_spend.label: Paid
paid_spend.definition: Payouts sent in the period, before TDS.

budget_used.label: Budget used
budget_used.definition: Accrued spend to date as a share of the campaign budget.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.definition: Eduwit's commission received in the period for enrolments from creator leads, excluding GST.

expected_revenue.label: Expected revenue
expected_revenue.definition: Eduwit's commission still to be received for enrolments from creator leads, excluding GST.

cost_per_qualified_lead.label: Cost per qualified lead
cost_per_qualified_lead.definition: Accrued spend divided by qualified leads.

net_roi.label: Net ROI
net_roi.definition: Revenue minus accrued spend, as a share of accrued spend.

roas.label: ROAS
roas.definition: Revenue for every rupee of accrued spend.

active_creators.label: Active creators
active_creators.definition: Creators whose status is Active now.

dormant_creators.label: Dormant
dormant_creators.definition: Creators with no recent activity (the dormancy period is in Settings → Creators).

overdue_deliverables.label: Overdue deliverables
overdue_deliverables.definition: Deliverables past their due date that are not live yet.

pending_reviews.label: Waiting for review
pending_reviews.definition: Concepts and drafts waiting for Eduwit's review.

pending_negotiations.label: In negotiation
pending_negotiations.definition: Deals and contracts waiting for an answer from either side.

contracts_expiring.label: Contracts ending soon
contracts_expiring.definition: Signed contracts whose deal ends in the next 30 days.

payouts_due.label: Payouts due
payouts_due.definition: Confirmed earnings that are due and not yet in a payout batch.

fraud_flags.label: Fraud flags
fraud_flags.definition: Open fraud flags waiting for review.

on_time_rate.label: On time
on_time_rate.definition: Share of deliverables due in the period that went live by their due date.

earned_total.label: Total earned
earned_total.definition: Everything you have earned so far, net of penalties and clawbacks, before tax.

earnings_pending.label: Pending
earnings_pending.definition: Earned, waiting for confirmation (for example until Eduwit receives its commission).

earnings_payable.label: Due to you
earnings_payable.definition: Confirmed and due. It goes out in the next payout run.

earnings_paid.label: Paid
earnings_paid.definition: Paid to your bank account so far, before TDS.

next_payout.label: Next payout
next_payout.definition: The date of the next payout run.

fixed_received.label: Fixed fees earned
fixed_received.definition: Fixed fees and milestones you have already earned on your deals.

fixed_remaining.label: Fixed fees to come
fixed_remaining.definition: Fixed fees and milestones still to earn on your agreed and active deals.

liabilities.label: Owed to creators
liabilities.definition: Earned and not yet paid, confirmed or not.

tds_deducted.label: TDS deducted
tds_deducted.definition: TDS deducted from payouts in the period.

receipts_waiting.label: Waiting on Eduwit's commission
receipts_waiting.definition: Creator commission that confirms once Eduwit receives its own commission.

receipts_flagged.label: Flagged enrolments
receipts_flagged.definition: Enrolments whose creator commission has waited longer than the reconciliation period.
